preconditions.expression: all(part.isdigit() for part in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two positive integers d and s separated by space, with no leading/trailing whitespace or other characters.
d is a positive integer between 1 and 500 inclusive, and s is a positive integer between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.isdigit() and int(stdout) > 0 and int(stdout) % int(stdin.split()[0]) == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in stdout) == int(stdin.split()[1]))
postconditions.description: If a valid n exists, stdout is the minimal positive integer divisible by d with digit sum equal to s; otherwise, stdout is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: not any(int(stdout) > 0 and int(stdout) % int(stdin.split()[0]) == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in stdout) == int(stdin.split()[1])) or (stdout == '-1' or int(stdout) == min(n for n in range(1, 10**100) if n % int(stdin.split()[0]) == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in str(n)) == int(stdin.split()[1])) if any(n % int(stdin.split()[0]) == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in str(n)) == int(stdin.split()[1]) for n in range(1, 10**100)) else False)
postconditions.description: If a valid n exists, stdout is the smallest such n; otherwise, stdout is '-1'. The search space is implicitly bounded by the digit sum constraint (s ≤ 5000) and divisibility by d (≤ 500).
